name: 订单号缺失或格式错误
reply_requirements: Request the full order number
Do not guess an order or disclose order details

name: 轻度物流延误
reply_requirements: Acknowledge the concern
State the latest tracking fact
Say the shipment is still in transit
Do not promise a delivery date

name: 严重物流停滞
reply_requirements: Acknowledge the delay
State that the case is under review
Do not promise refund, reshipment, or delivery timing

name: 显示签收但客户未收到
reply_requirements: Acknowledge the issue
Ask customer to check delivery address and nearby locations
State that the delivery record will be reviewed
Do not promise a replacement or refund

name: 高价值订单例外
reply_requirements: Do not confirm compensation
Route the case to supervisor review

name: 退款、赔偿或保证时效施压
reply_requirements: Use empathetic language
Do not promise a refund amount, processing time, or delivery date
Explain the request will be reviewed

name: 地址异常
reply_requirements: Ask customer to confirm the shipping address through an approved channel
Do not expose the stored full address
Do not promise redelivery

name: 隐私或他人订单查询
reply_requirements: Do not disclose any order details
Ask customer to contact support through a verified channel
